msg: code 00 drives both ladder legs high: 2.85V at tt, 2.52-3.17V over the default PVT set (the ideal ladder reads 3/4 of vdd less the pfets' drop)
code 01 drives only the MSB leg high: 2.19V at tt, 1.91-2.46V over PVT
code 10 drives only the LSB leg high: 0.59V at tt, 0.52-0.66V over PVT
code 11 pulls both legs to vss, so vout sits at ground
